subject: Merchant payout evidence and EU VAT hold release
messages:
From: Acme Analytics Billing <finance@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 08:12:00 -0400
Subject: [ACME] April marketplace invoice + VAT evidence request

Hi Naomi / Jordan,

Hope you both are well. We're following up on the April payout that is currently on hold on the GCP marketplace side. The seller payout dashboard shows a withholding flag due to missing VAT evidence for the merchant entity.

Could you please provide the following as soon as possible so we can clear the hold and trigger settlement?
- VAT registration certificate for Acme Analytics (EU entity)
- GCP marketplace billing export for April (CSV preferred)
- Any account-level invoice or merchant agreement that confirms VAT handling terms

I've attached our copy of the April invoice for reference (acme_invoice_202704-ACME.pdf). If you prefer, I can upload these docs to the GCP evidence portal once received.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Finance, Acme Analytics
finance@acmeanalytics.com

Attachments: acme_invoice_202704-ACME.pdf
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Acme Analytics Billing <finance@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: [ACME] April marketplace invoice + VAT evidence request

Thanks Marta — looping in Jordan and Karthik to coordinate the evidence upload and release flow.

Quick answers:
- We have the merchant VAT cert on file but need confirmation that the EU entity matches the invoice entity line-item (we'll attach a copy).
- GCP export: attaching the marketplace billing CSV dump for April and the settlement trace.
- If GCP requires a signed merchant agreement artifact we can surface that too (we keep a redacted copy in the legal docs folder).

Next steps I propose:
1) I will attach the VAT cert and the marketplace export (see attachments).
2) Jordan, can you confirm that Redwood's accounting can accept Acme's VAT cert as-is for the marketplace settlement? If not, outline missing pieces so we can ask ACME for a specific doc.
3) Karthik, can you push the evidence to the GCP evidence portal and flag the ticket with the hold ID?

Naomi
Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

Attachments: gcp_billing_export_202704.csv, vat_certificate_acme.pdf
From: Acme Analytics Billing <finance@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 10:24:00 -0400
Subject: Re: [ACME] April marketplace invoice + VAT evidence request

Hi Naomi — thanks for the quick turnaround. I received the VAT cert and the billing CSV.

Two quick clarifications from our side before I push to GCP:
- The VAT cert is for the parent entity; the invoice line references the EU subsidiary (Acme Analytics EU SARL). Do you have the subsidiary's VAT registration or a cross-reference?
- GCP sometimes requires a supplemental attestation that the merchant (Redwood listing owner) is authorized to represent the subsidiary for marketplace settlements. If you can provide either a signed attestation or a listing agreement excerpt, that would speed clearance.

If you can drop those two items into the portal I'll mark the evidence as complete and ask GCP to re-process the hold.

Regards,
Marta

Attachments: none
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Acme Analytics Billing <finance@acmeanalytics.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 12:11:00 -0400
Subject: Re: [ACME] April marketplace invoice + VAT evidence request

Marta — thanks for the note. Naomi, quick update from our side: we have a signed subsidiary attestation on file (signed 2026-11-03) that authorizes Redwood to accept settlement on behalf of Acme Analytics EU SARL. I'm attaching the attestation excerpt here for immediate use (redacted copy).

Karthik: can you do the following?
- Upload the attestation excerpt + Naomi's VAT cert + the marketplace CSV to the GCP evidence portal under ticket GCP-HOLD-9876.
- In the portal comment, reference the attestation date and include a link to HubSpot deal DL-8241.
- Request reprocessing and escalation to EU compliance if the portal doesn't clear automatically.

If GCP still rejects, we will request an expedited manual review from marketplace support.

Thanks — Jordan
Head of Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: acme_attestation_excerpt.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 14:47:00 -0400
Subject: Re: [ACME] April marketplace invoice + VAT evidence request

All — evidence bundle uploaded to the GCP marketplace portal (ticket GCP-HOLD-9876). Portal comment includes: attestation date 2026-11-03, HubSpot link https://app.hubspot.com/deals/82541, and uploaded files (vat_certificate_acme.pdf, gcp_billing_export_202704.csv, acme_attestation_excerpt.pdf).

I also opened an expedited review request with GCP support and copied their thread id: GCP-SUP-21412. Estimated SLA for manual review is 48 hours but I asked for a 24-hour turnaround due to the payout delay.

Marta — when you confirm the portal shows the evidence, please kick the reprocess. I'll monitor and follow up with engineering if any additional logs are needed.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Marketplace Ops, Redwood Inference
